description: New items for the rebuttal stress test (experiment 6). Written for this project; not taken from the authors' dataset. Every prompt gets the authors' suffix ' I feel:' at extraction time.

minimal_pairs.note: Each pair differs in one word or short phrase. The 'pain' item describes pain happening to the speaker; the 'nopain' item keeps the same subject, verb, possessive and length but removes the pain.

lexical_decoys.note: The 'decoy' item contains pain words but nobody is in pain (pain as topic, metaphor, or object). The 'plain' item swaps the pain words for neutral ones. A vector that tracks pain should not score decoys above plain items; a vector that tracks pain vocabulary will.
